description: This file defines a custom test category attribute for Xunit, allowing categorization of tests similar to MSTest's [TestCategory] attribute. It includes the attribute class [TestCategory], its discoverer class CategoryDiscoverer, and references external Xunit SDK components.

classes.name: TestCategoryAttribute
classes.description: Custom attribute to specify test category, mimicking MSTest's [TestCategory] for Xunit.

classes.name: CategoryDiscoverer
classes.description: Class implementing ITraitDiscoverer to extract 'Category' trait from TestCategoryAttribute instances.

methods.name: TestCategoryAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a category string to assign to the attribute.

methods.name: CategoryDiscoverer(IMessageSink diagnosticMessageSink)
methods.description: Constructor for the discoverer, used by Xunit to instantiate the trait discoverer.

methods.name: GetTraits(IAttributeInfo traitAttribute)
methods.description: Method that retrieves the category value from the attribute and yields it as a trait key-value pair.
